intent: Reproduce the vendor Form preset "Horns" (Lines); reference thumbnail: none shipped

prior_iterations.critique: The render has the essential Horns (Lines) character: luminous mint-white line strands, dotted particle traces, black field, and clearly changing geometry between t1 and t4. However, the composition is dominated by several oversized, clipped ribbons crossing through the frame, so the paired horn-like structure does not read cleanly. The brightest intersections also collapse into broad white bands, obscuring the finer line detail that makes the preset legible.
